stage_a.name: Stage A: Warmup / Frozen Backbone
stage_a.description: Backbone features are completely frozen. Only the decoupled neck (P3/P4) and detection heads are updated. Prevents high-variance random head gradients from corrupting pre-trained visual representations.
stage_a.trainable_layers: neck (P3/P4 lateral connections, smooth convolutions) and head_p3, head_p4

stage_b.name: Stage B: Partial Fine-Tuning / Deep Backbone Unfreeze
stage_b.description: Stem and early feature stages (C1, C2, C3) remain strictly frozen to preserve low-level primitive filters (edges, color textures). Deep Stage 4 feature representations are fine-tuned with a 10x lower learning rate.
stage_b.trainable_layers: backbone.features[7..18] (stage 4 deep layers, 214 parameter tensors), neck, head_p3, head_p4
